## [1.2.0](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* explain missing libil2cpp.so in Heads Up! patches ([927d395](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/927d395aa20074c115c3063898407a27d29b3c7a))
* show one empty custom deck in Heads Up! My Decks ([7bbc396](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/7bbc396edc543dd151ecd4aec1ece7909d8845e8))

### ✨ New Features

* Heads Up! – sort decks alphabetically ([cc85686](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/cc856862a9b7fc1cedb90427272ec936346a4382))
* Heads Up! – split hide empty custom decks into its own patch ([652cd79](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/652cd79a2979c23029ecbf2080b2b8cdd8f28289))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support Heads Up! 4.15.13 ([171e32a](https://gitlab.com/LOCKhart07/morphe-patches/commit/171e32a7dcf85ce550928cd02def26281de175f5))

patches.name: Hide empty custom decks
patches.description: Shows one empty custom deck in My Decks instead of all of them. A new one appears after you restart the app.

patches.name: Round length
patches.description: Adds an option to change the round length from the deck page.

patches.name: Sort decks alphabetically
patches.description: Sorts My Decks alphabetically instead of by recent purchases and plays.

patches.name: Unlock all decks
patches.description: Unlocks every deck without a purchase.
